title: Redis
description: Redis from redis_exporter (compose profile redis): memory against maxmemory, cache hit ratio, commands/s and latency, clients, evictions and expirations, keys per database. Demo cache + traffic come with the profile.

list.name: New image deployed
list.expr: (count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""}) unless count by (name, image) (container_last_seen{name!="", image!=""} offset 10m)) and on (name) (time() - container_start_time_seconds{name!=""} < 120)

panels.title: Memory used / max
panels.description: Share of maxmemory. Empty when maxmemory is 0 (no limit): then the host RAM is the limit.

panels.title: Hit ratio (5m)
panels.description: Reads that found the key. Low = cache too small or wrong keys.

panels.title: Evictions/s
panels.description: Keys dropped because memory hit maxmemory. Fine for a pure cache; data loss for anything else.

panels.title: Memory
panels.description: used = data + overhead; rss = what the OS sees. When used reaches maxmemory the eviction policy kicks in.

panels.title: Fragmentation ratio
panels.description: Above ~1.5: memory is wasted in fragments (activedefrag or a restart helps). Below 1: Redis is swapping.

panels.title: Average latency by command (top 10)
panels.description: Time Redis spends executing each command (network not included). Slow ones block every other client.

panels.title: Rejected connections/s
panels.description: Connections refused because maxclients was reached.

panels.title: Slow log entries
panels.description: Commands slower than slowlog-log-slower-than (default 10ms). See them with: redis-cli SLOWLOG GET 10

panels.title: Redis logs
panels.description: Container logs of Redis and its exporter.

panels.title: Memory full in
panels.description: At the 6h growth rate, time until used memory reaches maxmemory. Empty = not growing or no maxmemory.

panels.title: Slowlog entries
panels.description: Commands slower than slowlog-log-slower-than (default 10 ms) kept in the slowlog.

panels.title: Hit ratio over time
panels.description: A drop after a deploy = cache keys changed or TTLs too short.
